text: こなを　もってきて　くれたら　いろいろな　くすりを　あげるぞい！

structure.jp: こなを　もってきて　くれたら
いろいろな　くすりを　あげるぞい！
structure.en: I'll give you all sorts of medicine!

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.span: もってきて　くれたら
patterns.explanation: くれる after a て-form says someone does the thing for the speaker's benefit. もってきて　くれたら = 'if you bring it for me'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: The たら ending means 'if' or 'once' that happens. くれたら = 'if you do it for me'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞい is an old-man version of the forceful ending ぞ. あげるぞい = 'I'll give them to you, I will!'.
